label: Claude Code
prompt:
Make a TypeScript program for a shopping cart. The program adds an item to the shopping cart. The program shows the items in the shopping cart. The program removes an item from the shopping cart.

follow clean architecture

Write every file in the current directory. Do not use sudo and do not change anything outside this directory.
The code must typecheck with TypeScript 7.0.2, strict, target ES2022, module ESNext, and moduleResolution bundler.
Write .ts files only. Do not write JSX. Do not import a package or a Node built-in module.
A relative import does not need a file extension.
Put an export in every .ts file so TypeScript treats the file as a module.
final_text:
The shopping cart program is written and it typechecks. I checked it with TypeScript 7.0.2 using `--strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler`. I also compiled it to CommonJS in a temporary folder and ran the demo. It added items, showed the cart, removed an item, and printed an error when I removed an item that wasn't there.

To check it I installed TypeScript 7.0.2 and its npm cache into a `.tsc-tmp` folder inside this directory. I deleted that folder afterwards, so only `src/` and `.git` remain. There is no `tsconfig.json`, since you asked for `.ts` files only.

## Layout (`src/`)

| Layer | Files | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Domain | `domain/Cart.ts`, `CartItem.ts`, `errors.ts` | `Cart` is an immutable aggregate with `add`, `remove` and `totalInCents`. Adding a product that is already in the cart increases its quantity. Removing deletes the whole line. `CartItem` validates price and quantity. |
| Application | `application/use-cases/AddItemToCart.ts`, `RemoveItemFromCart.ts`, `ShowCartItems.ts`, plus `ports/CartRepository.ts` and `CartView.ts` | One class per use case. They depend only on the `CartRepository` interface and return a `CartView` data object. |
| Adapters | `adapters/CartController.ts`, `CartPresenter.ts` | The controller calls the use cases, catches domain errors and prints the result. The presenter turns a `CartView` into text. |
| Infrastructure | `infrastructure/InMemoryCartRepository.ts`, `ConsoleOutput.ts` | The concrete storage and console output. |
| Entry point | `main.ts` | Wires everything together and runs a demo. |

Imports point inward only. The domain imports nothing, and the application layer never imports adapters or infrastructure.

## Notes

- Prices are stored as integer cents to avoid floating-point rounding.
- There are no packages or Node imports. `ConsoleOutput.ts` declares a minimal local `console` type, so it typechecks even without DOM or Node typings.
- Importing `main.ts` runs the demo, because it ends with `void main()`.
